summary: This is a 1-page poster paper (FPGA 2025, categorized as W10/poster) that presents an empirical comparison of LLM-based hardware design vs HLS. The paper describes a prompting methodology for guiding LLMs (Claude 3.5 Sonnet) to generate synthesizable Verilog, using PolyBench benchmarks. No code availability statement, GitHub link, or repository is mentioned anywhere in the paper. The paper is a methodology/comparison study rather than a software artifact release. Despite thorough searching of the paper text, GitHub (by title, keywords, code content, and authors' organization/accounts), and the web, no dedicated repository for this paper was found. I am confident there is no public code repository associated with this specific paper.
